svg.aria-label: A sequence diagram showing the Worker doing four short calls and then handing the upstream event stream back to the browser without reading it.
svg.title: The handoff
svg.desc: The browser posts an image and parameters to the Worker. The Worker uploads the image to the Gradio Space, submits the job, receives an event id, opens the server-sent event stream for it, and returns that response body as its own without reading a byte. The events then flow from the Space through Cloudflare to the browser, which parses the complete event and pulls the video URL out of it.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Worker returns a stream it never reads.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four short calls, then it hands the upstream response body straight back and steps out. A sixty second generation costs it the same as a one second one.

svg.text: Cloudflare pipes the bytes between two sockets it already holds. The Worker is not in this line.

svg.text: The browser does the SSE parsing, finds the complete event, and pulls the video URL out of the first element of the return tuple.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An earlier version read the stream inside the Worker and returned JSON, which kept it awake and billed for the whole generation. That is the trade.
